target.title: fix(agents): terminate agent run on critical tool-loop veto instead of continuing indefinitely
target.body:
Closes #106231

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users with loop detection enabled would keep burning model tokens for hours after a critical tool-loop action=block, because the blocked tool result was returned to the model normally and the agent loop continued indefinitely. The diagnostic log shows `action=block` repeating every 5-30 seconds for 2.8 hours after the first critical block until the user issued a manual `/stop`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Critical tool-loop vetoes from `buildBlockedToolResult` now carry `terminate: true`, which tells agent-core's `shouldTerminateToolBatch` to end the current tool batch. When every finalized result in a batch sets `terminate: true`, `hasMoreToolCalls` becomes false and the agent loop exits. Plugin-before-tool-call and plugin-approval vetoes remain non-terminating.

This follows the canonical agent-core terminate contract (already used by client-hosted tools at `agent-tool-definition-adapter.ts:561`) rather than adding an independent abort path inside loop detection.

## User Impact

When loop detection reaches a critical threshold, OpenClaw blocks the looping tool **and** terminates the agent run so the model cannot keep retrying the blocked call. Warning thresholds and post-compaction guard behavior are unchanged.

## Evidence

**Unit tests — terminate flag behavior (4/4 passed):**
```
agent-tools.before-tool-call.blocked-result.test.ts
  ✓ includes terminate: true for critical tool-loop vetoes
  ✓ does not include terminate for plugin-before-tool-call vetoes
  ✓ does not include terminate for plugin-approval vetoes
  ✓ defaults deniedReason to plugin-before-tool-call when omitted
```

**E2E tool-loop detection (83/83 passed):**
`expectToolLoopBlockedResult` now asserts `record.terminate === true` on every critical block path (generic_repeat, known_poll_no_progress, ping_pong). All 83 tests green.

**Tool-loop detection core (56/56 passed):**
No regression in loop detection, result hashing, or threshold logic.

**Agent-core terminate contract (25/25 passed):**
Full `agent-loop.test.ts` suite green, including the critical proof:
- "stops after a tool result only when the finalized result explicitly terminates" — proves the full stack: blocked result with terminate → loop exits
- "continues after a side-effect tool result when afterToolCall records it without terminate" — proves non-blocked results still continue

**Whitespace:** `git diff --check` — clean

**Format:** `oxfmt --check` on all touched files — clean

**Type check:** `pnpm tsgo` — no errors

**Changes scope:**
```
 docs/tools/loop-detection.md                          |  5 +++--
 src/agents/agent-tools.before-tool-call.e2e.test.ts   |  4 ++++
 src/agents/agent-tools.before-tool-call.ts            | 10 +++++++++-
 src/agents/agent-tools.before-tool-call.blocked-result.test.ts | 59 +++++++++++++++++++++++
 4 files changed, 74 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)
```

**Proof chain (how the fix works end-to-end):**
1. `buildBlockedToolResult({ deniedReason: "tool-loop" })` sets `terminate: true` on the blocked result
2. agent-core's `executeToolCalls` → `shouldTerminateToolBatch(finalizedCalls)` checks `every(finalized.result.terminate === true)` at `agent-loop.ts:807`
3. When every call in the batch terminates, the batch returns `terminate: true` at `agent-loop.ts:688`
4. The main loop exits via `hasMoreToolCalls = !executedToolBatch.terminate` at `agent-loop.ts:364`
5. No more model turns are requested — run terminates

**Non-goals:** No changes to `loopDetection` config, warning thresholds, detectors, post-compaction guard, abort/signal machinery, or non-tool-loop blocked results.
